title: The front door reads on a phone

text:
**255px of header down to 133px** at 400px wide - three lines instead of six. Desktop unchanged at 76px. No console errors either width.

The four links, the card-width slider and the two disabled tabs (gallery, dashboard) now fold behind one **More** button below 40em. Nothing is deleted at any width - Live, the author filter, the count, the picker and the three real tabs never hide.

It missed the 120px target I set and said so rather than rounding. 133 is the real number.
